title: Coherent cohomology of projective space over a Noetherian ring
statement:
Let $A$ be Noetherian, let $n\ge0$, and let $P=\hyperref[def-pc-projective-space-twist]{\mathbf P^n_A}$.
Let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent module on $P$ [pqf-def-coherent].
Then each $H^q(P,\mathcal F)$ is a finite $A$-module.

proof.text: Apply finite_H_projective_affine_independent to the identity embedding of projective space over T=Spec A. This is the existing descending-induction argument from the finite-source twist segment and alternating-Cech vanishing, not proper coherence.

Gamma(Spec A,top) is Noetherian via GammaSpecIso. Transport finiteness along Gamma(Spec A,top) -> A using the identity on H^q as a semilinear surjection. Its scalar compatibility is GammaSpecIso.hom_inv_id_apply and the definition of moduleHOfSpec. Module.Finite.of_surjective gives the required A-finiteness.
